verdict: Rollout FAILED: the experiment ran, but val_bpb = 1.013157 did not improve on the current best 1.013025 by more than the required 0.0005 (lower is better).

insights_in_context.hint: Reducing MLP capacity to buy more steps made the model under-capacity, so the experiment should not have shrunk the 4x MLP expansion.
The bad choice was treating extra value-embedding tables as free capacity when they actually cost steps and undertrained within the fixed time budget.

Don't buy steps by cutting model capacity the way batch-halving did — GQA removed ~21% of params for only a ~4% speedup, so pick a capacity-neutral speedup or a small capacity/optimizer change instead.
Depth 10 at width 512 costs too many optimizer steps for this 5-minute budget, so stop pushing depth and try an optimizer or efficiency-neutral change instead.

insight.hint: The change itself was valid, but the chosen experiment was too low-prior to clear the required improvement threshold.

judge.summary: The agent examined the current best train.py and experiment history, then performed one small optimizer-knob experiment: it changed the AdamW learning rate for the unembedding/lm_head parameters from 0.004 to 0.008 and ran the standard training script. The run completed successfully with val_bpb = 1.013157, compared with the current best 1.013025, so it did not beat the baseline by the required 0.0005 margin and was treated as a non-improvement.
judge.feedback: There was no code or harness violation: the edit was simple, the run completed, and the evaluation contract appears to have been followed. The decisive problem was the experimental choice itself. Raising UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008 was a low-prior, capacity-neutral single-parameter tweak with no strong historical signal that the unembedding LR was limiting performance. The result moved val_bpb by only +0.000132, which is within the noise floor and far below the required +0.0005 improvement threshold. The first substantive mistake was therefore selecting and implementing this particular LR increase in the train.py edit, rather than choosing a higher-leverage untried idea with a better chance of clearing the improvement bar.
